title: BATWA v2.4.51 Settings & Dashboard @username Handle Sync
message: Replaced all generic fallback labels in Settings and Dashboard with dynamic personal @username handles and verified tags.
features: Settings @username Title: Prominently displays user's personal @tag in the Hero card and KYC profile.
Universal Tag Resolution: Fallback labels dynamically resolve to active P2P handle across all screens.
Clean QR Layout: Restored classic verified P2P QR design with clutter-free controls.
Zero Default Fallbacks: Complete removal of generic fallback labels from storage and view models.
changelog: Replaced 'Batwa Member' in Settings with dynamic user @username handle as requested.
Updated Hero card and NADRA identity preview in DrawerUnderlayScreen to prioritize @tag.
Synchronized Dashboard and BalanceCard handle resolution.
